message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is a “soft” card because it can be counted as either **1** or **11**, depending on which value gives your hand the best chance of winning without busting.  

- If counting the Ace as 11 keeps your total ≤ 21, you’ll usually treat it as 11.  
- If adding 11 would push you over 21, you treat it as 1 instead.  

This flexibility also applies when you’re dealt two Aces: one will normally count as 11 and the other as 1 (unless you split them). The ability to switch between 1 and 11 is what makes Aces so valuable in Blackjack.
